name: TransitionWarpHelper
key_decisions: _warp_position is a pure helper with no pygame dependency
INWARD_OFFSET is defined as PLAYER_SPEED + 1 to avoid immediate re-transition
warp uses mirror mapping plus perpendicular clamp for each cardinal direction
invalid warp requests raise ValueError for sealed edges, unknown rooms, and bad directions
public_symbols: _warp_position(room: Room, exit_dir: str, x: int, y: int) -> tuple[Room, int, int]
risks: R4 — hold-to-retrigger loops if inward offset is too small
R6 — bad neighbor ids if registry authoring regresses
